themes.name: Agentic AI in research

themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that help developers write, debug, and review code, acting as copilots in the development process.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI-powered tools designed to assist users in gathering, processing, and synthesizing information for research purposes.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles discussing AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or information into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Content that reviews, compares, and assesses the effectiveness and utility of various AI tools for research and design.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Research and discussion on how AI is affecting jobs, skill requirements, and the overall labor market.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Articles detailing how AI can augment or transform the creative and investigative processes in design and user research.

themes.name: AI content generation
themes.description: Focuses on AI's capabilities in creating new content, such as text, images, or code.

themes.name: AI for product management
